what: Several photo columns beside the Hero start drifting very slowly in opposite directions, linearly, as soon as it opens — even columns come down from 1000px above and odd columns go up 1000px, passing once over 75 seconds and stopping. It is not a repeating band but a slow pan of site photos drifting past, so for the first few seconds it looks almost still

options.offset: Value (px) raising the hall pillar start position further up, default 0 — so the two pillar photo rows look staggered
options.wait: If play, starts when fx:play arrives on the element (after the loader)
options.--fx-gap: Gap between columns and photos (css variable), default 12px
options.[data-fx-part=col]: Columns — two or more. Stack photos in each column longer than the board height + dist so it never runs empty before the end
